property_summary: For any player and any block state, calling play() with exactly TICKET_AMOUNT (with a bank that can receive Ether) never reverts, because a winning draw pays out cleanly and zeroes pot; the mutant zeroes pot before computing pot - FEE_AMOUNT, so every winning play underflows and reverts, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Move `pot = 0;` to the beginning of the `if (random == 0)` block, causing the payout subtraction to underflow and revert, leaving pot at its accumulated value.
